exchanges: eli's bar mitzvah is in 3 months and i havent done anyhting
Three months is still workable. Let's figure out what's already set.
the date and the shul. thats it lol
Those are the two hardest to move, so you're in better shape than you think.
ok true. his tutor is rabbi goldfarb and eli actually likes him which is a miracle
A tutor a 13-year-old actually likes is half the battle. How's his Torah portion going?
slow but ok. party after is at a hall, need a caterer
Are you thinking kosher catering, or is that flexible for your family?
has to be kosher for my inlaws. theres a woman miriam who runs a kosher place, she grew up in montreal so she does real montreal bagels
Real Montreal bagels on a kosher spread would be a hit. Worth getting a quote.
yes. funny thing my mother in law is also miriam
Two Miriams, that'll make the emails interesting.
lol. MIL miriam is flying in from haifa, she lives there since like 2010
Haifa's a long flight, it'll mean a lot to Eli that she's coming.
it will. my dad saul is coming too but hes just had hip surgery so he needs a seat near the door
Easy to plan around. Maybe a chair with arms so he can get up easily.
oh good thinking
Small things like that make a big difference while he recovers.
my brother ari is coming down from vermont on his motorcycle, hes insane
Vermont on a motorcycle is quite the entrance. Hopefully the weather's kind to him.
hes bringing his gf talia who weve never met
First time meeting the family at a big event, Talia's brave.
dj is a guy named marcus, eli picked him bc he does magic tricks between songs
A DJ with tricks up his sleeve is perfect for a room full of thirteen-year-olds.
the kids will lose it
In the best way.
eli's best freind kenji is doing a reading at the service
That's a nice way to include his friend. Does Kenji need any coaching?
nah hes a theatre kid, he'll be fine
Theatre kids rarely need help with an audience.
lol true. oh wait the gf's name isnt talia its tamar, ari just texted, i had it totally wrong
Tamar, got it. Good thing you caught it before the name cards.
omg yes that would have been bad
Very. Speaking of cards, are you doing a seating chart?
ugh yes. 140 ppl
Start with the family tables and the kids' table, then fill in.
kids table is gonna be chaos
With that DJ, the chaos might at least be entertained.
lol. need a theme too, eli wants basketball
Basketball is easy to theme: centrepieces, colours, maybe a hoop for the kids.
hes obsessed with the celtics so green and white
Green and white is crisp, it'll look good in photos.
my sister rachel is making the centerpieces, shes super crafty
Handmade centrepieces from his aunt will feel personal.
she does pottery so maybe little ceramic basketballs?
That would be a really unique keepsake for each table.
ok im gonna ask her tmrw
Sounds good. You made a lot of progress tonight.
